title: Session security, token protection, continuous access evaluation, and measuring what users ACTUALLY sign in with
content_md: MFA to Passkeys in Microsoft Entra ID series · Part 5 of 7 A passkey proves who the user is at the moment of sign-in. Then Entra ID hands out tokens so the user doesn't have to prove it again for every email, file and Teams message. Those tokens are what attackers want in the end, and some of the ways to steal them never touch the sign-in page. This doesn't weaken the case for passkeys. It defines where passkeys stop and other controls take over.
